schedulerCostProbe.purpose: Prove that equal ticks/input/seeds alone do not determine deferred-work admission when elapsed host work is authoritative. This does not prove a particular Game desync occurred.
schedulerCostProbe.performanceOverride: Temporary harness-only object restored in finally; deterministic virtual work costs only, never performance results.

blockers.concreteGap: Offers use performance.now deadlines, while that same API meters traffic work and streaming jobs. Freezing/virtualizing it changes admitted work; leaving it real permits different publish ticks under different host load.

this.credit -= elapsed; this.frameLeft -= elapsed; this.spentMs += elapsed;

blockers.requiredEngineering: After reference determinism passes, benchmark baseline/candidate sequentially in alternating order at equal quality, resolution, populations and residency with the same renderer/backend. Use >=3 pairs, medians and MAD; use five when improvement is within normal variance. Keep CPU, GPU, loader and native-input evidence separate.

boundedFeasibleAlternative: A fully resident synthetic Game integration fixture with actual Player/traffic/order/rail logic and explicit engine/loader doubles could test bounded semantic behavior. It must be labeled as such; it would not close whole-city streaming, rendering, save lifecycle and paired performance gates by itself.
